reasoningChain.evidence: The knight needs gear before the revised lineup can fairly test the boss.
The swap lowered equipped power by 389 because the incoming knight did not carry the mage's equipment.
The available legendary gloves show a 200.8 fit gain for the knight and combine armor with physical power, shield break, lifesteal, might, and execution damage.
This item adds both the newly accepted durability and the direct-damage traits I still value, making it a better boss preparation than an immediate under-geared retry.
